intent: Retain immutable incident v1/v2 execution bundles so persisted executions resume after upgrade with their exact plan, handler semantics and external signal bindings while new executions start on active v2.
invariants: Persisted non-terminal executions are dispatched only to the execution bundle matching their PlanDigest.
An execution bundle pins plan graph, version-specific handler semantics and external signal bindings together.
Cryptographic callback verification uses the node binding resolved from the persisted execution bundle, never an unconditional current-plan constant.
Read-model Explain and Diagnostics use the plan/engine matching the persisted execution bundle.
Unknown non-terminal persisted bundle identity fails closed rather than being silently skipped.
New incident executions start only on the active v2 bundle.
Historical v1 state is never silently migrated or reinterpreted as v2.
External notifications remain idempotent across restart and version routing.
